title: Persisted Health Bank record
description: A source assertion or explicitly identified interpretation. Ingest inputs may omit fields that the store supplies; this schema describes the persisted envelope.

record_id.description: SHA-256 identity of canonical assertion content, prefixed rec_.

patient_id.description: Local opaque patient identifier; not a patient name.

lane.description: Stable lane identifier. See lanes.json; extensions are allowed.

kind.description: Extractor-specific assertion type within the lane.

status.description: Unmodified source status when present; unknown when absent. Coverage status is separate.

data.description: Lossless JSON data, including narrative and original values. Any valid JSON type is permitted; object data is preferred for structured assertions.

captured_at.description: Time first persisted, not the clinical time. Additional provenance is retained in evidence.jsonl.

system.description: Source namespace such as the organization/portal/export origin.

artifact_sha256.description: Hash of preserved artifact bytes; null declares a provenance gap.

locator.description: Precise XPath, page/section, message/item identifier, byte location or structured location. Null declares a provenance gap.

record_key.description: Stable source item identifier used to relate revisions; null when unavailable.

effective_time.description: Clinical or administrative applicability time. Partial and unparsed dates must not acquire false precision.

start.description: Source-preserving start value, potentially a partial date.

end.description: Source-preserving end value when an interval is known.

precision.description: For example year, month, day, minute, second, interval or unknown; not restricted to these labels.

original.description: Original source timestamp text or structured time representation.
